title: Oracle C2M Monitoring & Alerting with Dynatrace
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (Oracle Utilities C2M + WebLogic 14c administration; middleware/database/integration work, production-impact care).

Oracle Utilities C2M/CC&B/MDM + WebLogic 14c authored from Oracle's official product + OUAF docs; version-specific details (C2M 25.4/min v2.9, WebLogic 14c) cited or flagged 'verify for your version'; My-Oracle-Support-gated patches/notes are pointed to, not reproduced. Automation is WLST (Jython)/shell/SQL, not PowerShell.
hook: See C2M health in Dynatrace before users feel it
problem: Once C2M is live, you need to see problems before users do. This solution sets up Dynatrace monitoring and alerting for Oracle C2M and its WebLogic 14c middleware: instrument the JVM/WebLogic tiers, build the service/infra dashboards, and define standardized alerts on the signals that matter — so the team responds to health, not surprises, pilot-first.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — what to monitor across C2M/WebLogic (JVM, services, batch, endpoints) and how Dynatrace instruments and alerts on it.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Dynatrace tenant/OneAgent, C2M environment access, alerting destinations).
Implementation Guide — exact steps to instrument the WebLogic/JVM tiers with Dynatrace, build the C2M dashboards, and define standardized alerts + notification, then validate coverage, pilot-first.

5 automation scripts (WLST/Jython, shell & SQL) — environment/config discovery, per-node validation, a health/coverage report, safe remediation (dry-run by default), and a scope/target helper — authentic to C2M & WebLogic administration.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (instrumented, dashboards live, alerts fire) plus Best Practices for alert tuning and noise reduction.
short: Set up Dynatrace monitoring and alerting for Oracle C2M and WebLogic 14c — instrument the tiers, build dashboards, define standardized alerts — so the team sees problems before users do, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: Set up Dynatrace monitoring and alerting for Oracle C2M and WebLogic 14c — instrument the tiers, build dashboards, define standardized alerts — so the team sees problems before users do, pilot-first.
